//exclude: tests/ is excluded because Node's own test runner needs the explicit .ts extension on its
imports to strip types at runtime, and tsc refuses that extension unless
allowImportingTsExtensions is on, which conflicts with how Next builds this app. Excluding
the directory is the smaller compromise: the tests run under `node --test tests/`, the app
compiles unchanged, and neither has to bend for the other. The tests still type-check in
practice because they import the real module and would fail loudly on a shape change.
